cells.gaps: No regulation under Law 09-08 has been found either way; the CNDP's model-form deliberations are its own and are not read as regulations. No sanction by the CNDP on a named controller is held; the 2024 count is of court cases.
cells.note: Law 09-08 is in force and the Supreme Council of the Judicial Power counts 80 criminal data protection cases decided in 2024 (MAR-040), with a named 2024 conviction (MAR-041), so stage 4. Stage 5 needs regulations issued, which no row shows.
